name: Magic Hash
description: MAGNE.AI is a full-stack ecosystem focused on secure digital asset ownership and AI-native computation. The project integrates hardware, blockchain infrastructure, and artificial intelligence into a unified platform. Its core offering, MAGNE Phone Gen1, is a Web3-native smartphone designed for private AI workflows and hardware-level cryptographic asset protection. Beyond hardware, MAGNE.AI operates MAGNE Layer 1 (for device identity and ownership logic), M Hash Layer 2 (for scalable execution), and is developing edge AI infrastructure including the MAGNE AI BOX for local model inference and the MAGNE Agent Pay protocol for AI-driven payments. The project addresses the growing need for user-controlled AI and digital assets in an increasingly connected world.
